recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13478 unless a future terminology decision renames or relocates the ConceptMapRelationship value-set page.
issue_request: FHIR-13478 asked to repair the broken ConceptMapEquivalence value-set link in the ConceptMap $translate operation's match.equivalence output-parameter description on the conceptmap-operations page. Jira records the issue as Published/Persuasive for STU3 with a 2018-02-22 Vocab vote of 7-0-0.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 13451, represented by git commit f5dd8cd441a10d1960a13e722ba76150959be011, which changed source/conceptmap/conceptmap-spreadsheet.xml from malformed markdown using {concept-map-equivalence.html} to [ConceptMapEquivalence](valueset-concept-map-equivalence.html).
additional_context: The 2021 core source rework removed the old ConceptMap spreadsheet and introduced source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml as the current operation definition source. Current ConceptMap uses match.relationship/ConceptMapRelationship, and the operation definition links to valueset-concept-map-relationship.html. source/fhir.ini actively lists ConceptMap as a current resource, and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion; Confluence searches found the Vocabulary block-vote/minutes evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the original broken link is gone, the historically edited spreadsheet is obsolete, and the current authoritative operation definition already contains a valid value-set link.
